# Git Merge Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > Git

## Overview

Manages Git merge strategies including squash merges, rebasing, and conflict resolution for clean repository history

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [git-merge-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
git-merge-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@git-merge-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Resolve complex merge conflicts
- Implement squash merge for clean history
- Use interactive rebase for commit cleanup
- Configure merge strategies per branch

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Merge Strategies**: Git merge and rebase patterns
- **Conflict Resolution**: Merge conflict resolution approaches
- **Squash Merge**: Commit squashing for clean history
